name: sla-timer
title: SLA timer
description: Time left on a service target: on track, at risk or breached, with a paused state while waiting on the customer.
docs: deadline and startedAt are the target and when its clock started; the line reads First response in 12 min (label is the words before the time, with the preposition: First response in, Resolve within; without it the line reads 12 min left), then Breached by 25 min once the deadline has passed. The state is written as well as styled: On track, At risk (when a quarter of the target is left, or thresholds says otherwise with atRiskFraction or atRiskMinutes), Breached and Paused, each with its own icon. pausedAt stops the clock and the line reads Paused: waiting on customer (change the reason with pausedReason). businessHours { days, start, end, timeZone } counts working time only, across clock changes, and shows hours rather than days. Time is worked out from timestamps and refreshed once a minute and when a sleeping tab wakes; the ticking is never announced, only a change of state is, politely and once. A thin bar shows how much of the target has gone (showProgress), and the tooltip, on hover, on focus and on a tap, gives the exact deadline. Pass now to get the words in server HTML, in tests and in previews; without it the server shows the due date until the clock is known. locale and timeZone format numbers and dates, labels translates every word.
